report.title: Season & Trend Analysis
a4.desc.season: Which monthly search patterns repeat every year?
a4.desc.trend: What changed in the last 12 months (vs the 12 months before)?
a4.desc.updown: What rose and fell in the last 3 months (QoQ · YoY)?
cover.bg: This report analyzes 48 months of search volume for keywords searched together with '{seed}' to show when searches rise each year in the {market} ({engines}) market and which searches have recently grown or shrunk. Keywords were collected from ListeningMind related-search and co-search data, and monthly search volume was used to identify seasonal keywords that repeat every year, last-12-month trends, and last-3-month risers and fallers.
mk.title: Seasonal keywords by month
mk.s1b: Two consecutive months count as one window, so a peak that shifts by a month from year to year still counts as the same season.
mk.s2b: In at least 3 of the 4 years, the month with the most searches falls in that window.
mk.s3b: The seasonal index (that month's searches ÷ that year's monthly average, median over 4 years) is 1.4 or higher. Keywords that pass are listed by their average volume in that month.
cal.title: Seasonal calendar by theme
cal.none: No seasonal keywords that repeat every year were found within the themes.
ev.foot: Seasonal index = 4-year median of the month's multiple of that year's monthly average.
yc.title: Monthly search volume of '{seed}' by year
yc.foot: Monthly search volume of the seed query '{seed}'.
ud.title: Rising and falling keywords
ud.s1b: Keywords whose last 3 months exceed the previous 3 months.
ud.s2h: vs previous 3 months + same 3 months last year (QoQ+YoY)
ud.s2b: Keywords whose last 3 months exceed both the previous 3 months and the same 3 months last year.
ud.foot: Falling is the opposite of each condition. Both views show the top 20 by QoQ change, and keywords with fewer than 10 searches in a compared period are left out.
trd.title: Key trends
trd.lead:
Queries whose last-12-month volume is at least 1.5 times or at most half of the previous 12 months, or that newly appeared, grouped by shared movement. Only queries with at least 5,000 searches in either 12-month period are considered.
Changes for individual queries are in Trends by theme below.
trd.none: No movement meets the criteria above.
yr.title: Trends by theme
tr.foot: Search volume is {engines} monthly search volume.
js.c2b: Criterion: 1.4 or higher · searched {v}x that year's monthly average (4-year median)
js.c3b: Average {m} search volume over 4 years (years with no searches excluded)
js.yoyB: Last 3 months {a} · same 3 months last year {b}
js.trAria: Monthly search volume for the two periods
